texts.orig: 1. In [2], the authors compute the ample cone for Hilbert modular surface, by constructing partial Hasse invariants and studying intersection theory on the surface directly.
texts.text: In [2], the authors compute the ample cone for Hilbert modular surface, by constructing partial Hasse invariants and studying intersection theory on the surface directly.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2. In [40], the authors conjectured the ampleness criterion for U ( 2 ) /Hilbert/quaternionic Shimura varieties. They studied the geometric description of Goren-Oort strata and proved the necessity part of the criterion.

texts.orig: 3. In [45], the author proved the ampleness criterion conjectured by [40], by computing the intersection numbers using the description of strata.

texts.orig: 4. In the unpublished paper [5], the authors proposed a sufficiency criterion for ampleness for Hodge type Shimura varieties. However, their bound is known to be not sharp.
